text: the slope button is it a seperate brush or what? its in the brush area but it doesnt highlight when clicking on it
resolution: Clarified and fixed the slope tool selection behavior. Slope is a separate height mode using the same brush engine, not a separate layer; PaintCanvas was incorrectly normalizing heightMode='slope' back to 'brush', so the slope chip could not stay highlighted. Updated mode normalization to preserve slope, then reran the focused heightData test and fast hmsc-int ship build.
